buyerProtection.title: Buyer Protection
buyerProtection.description: Buying across borders should not mean carrying the risk alone.
buyerProtection.intro: Every order placed through AURION Markets is covered. If your goods never arrive, arrive damaged, or are not what the listing described, you can raise a claim and we will put it right. Vendors are paid out only on sales that stand.
buyerProtection.neverArrivedBody: If a vendor has not delivered within the stated window, you can claim at any time — there is no deadline on goods you never received.
buyerProtection.damagedBody: Goods that reach you broken, spoiled or unusable are covered. Photographs help us resolve the claim quickly.
buyerProtection.notDescribedBody: If what arrived differs materially from the listing — wrong grade, wrong weight, wrong item — the sale is not what you agreed to.
buyerProtection.step1: Open the order in your account and choose “Report a problem” on the item concerned.
buyerProtection.step2: Tell us what went wrong and add any detail that helps.
buyerProtection.step3: Our team reviews the claim alongside the vendor's fulfilment record.
buyerProtection.step4: If we uphold it, the vendor's payout for that item is reversed and you are refunded.
buyerProtection.claimWindowBody: Once an item is marked delivered you have 30 days to raise a claim. Items that have not been delivered can be claimed at any time. An order can be cancelled outright, without a claim, any time before the vendor hands it to a carrier.
